# Reused upstream

These unmodified domain modules come from [KimYx0207/dot-task-board](https://github.com/KimYx0207/dot-task-board/tree/0bba54b5361b38ba5a5d985f267a742801b4547d), stable v0.2.0, MIT.
They validate imported selected-task snapshots; imports remain reported observations, never verified execution or delivery.
The SOS local adapter, task UI and diagnostic bridge are separate integration code. No preview-branch dispatch engine, account service, role artwork or upstream cloud deployment is included.
